stem.text: A voltmeter is used to monitor the operation of an electric motor. The motor speed is controlled by a variable resistor. A fixed resistor is used to limit the speed.
The current in the motor is gradually changed.
In which circuit is the voltmeter reading proportional to the current in the motor?
